notes.title: Love the game?
notes.content: [h3][b]If you like the game, could you spare a minute to leave a review?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We're so close to the magic "10 reviews" point on Steam, any help getting there and [b]supporting the game with a review[/b] is super appreciated![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447390/WET/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks to those that have already reviewed us :)[/p][p][/p][p]The team at Super Hyper Mega[/p][p][/p]
